name: GSMArena
methodology: In-house reviews on retail or review units. Battery: Active Use Score, an estimate of runtime under a mix of calls, web browsing, video and gaming. Charging: from empty with the maker's charger, recorded at 15 and 30 minutes and at full. Display: light-meter readings of a 75% white patch in manual and auto modes, plus a small-patch peak. Benchmarks: highest of several runs.
notes: Test methods changed in 2025 (the Active Use Score replaced the older Endurance rating), so scores are only compared within the current method.

name: Notebookcheck
methodology: Processor pages list the median and range of results gathered from Notebookcheck's own reviews and verified benchmark databases. News articles often summarise tests by other labs and credit them.

name: UL Benchmarks (3DMark)
methodology: Official 3DMark device database maintained by UL, the benchmark's developer. Device pages report scores aggregated from submitted runs.

name: Geekbench Browser
methodology: Public database of user-submitted Geekbench runs from Primate Labs. Individual listings are unverified and can come from pre-release units, so single results carry low weight.

name: Geekerwan
methodology: Chinese hardware lab channel known for SoC analysis: SPEC CPU2017 performance-per-watt curves, GPU power measured at the board, and sustained gaming frame-rate and power logging.
notes: Records are currently entered from reports that credit Geekerwan (for example Notebookcheck). Direct extraction from Geekerwan videos is planned. Channel URL not recorded.

name: Mrwhosetheboss
methodology: Real-world battery rundowns that run several phones side by side through the same scripted routine, plus thermal checks with a thermal camera. Runs are single passes, so results are only compared within the same test.

name: Marques Brownlee (MKBHD)
methodology: Long-form experience reviews. Findings are qualitative observations rather than measurements.

name: JerryRigEverything
methodology: Durability tests: Mohs hardness picks on the display, scratch tests on the frame and camera, burn and bend tests. Repeatable procedure, one unit per test.

name: PhoneBuff
methodology: Side-by-side drop tests using a drop rig; one unit per phone.

name: Matthew Moniz
methodology: Experience and long-term reviews. Qualitative.

name: Gizmochina
methodology: Publishes benchmark comparisons that combine its own runs with results from other outlets. The method is not always documented, so its scores count as secondary database evidence.

name: Beebom
methodology: In-house benchmark runs (Geekbench, 3DMark stress tests) on retail phones; the test device is not always named.

name: Lowyat.NET
notes: Malaysian technology news; useful for local pricing and availability.

name: SoyaCincau
notes: Malaysian technology news; publishes official Malaysian launch prices and dates.

name: TechNave
notes: Malaysian technology news and reviews; reports Malaysian launch prices, availability and China launches. Headlines only; not evidence until an article is read and added.

name: Zing Gadget
notes: Malaysian technology news written in Chinese (马来西亚中文科技媒体): Malaysian launch prices, dates and local availability. Headlines only; not evidence until an article is read and added.

name: Malay Mail
notes: Malaysian national news outlet; its tech section reports official local pricing.

name: Nasi Lemak Tech
notes: Malaysian technology blog; used for local prices where larger outlets could not be read.

name: NanoReview
methodology: SoC and phone comparison database (AnTuTu, Geekbench, 3DMark, and its own ratings).
notes: Registered but holds no records yet. Automated access is blocked, so data must be entered by hand with attribution, following the site's terms.

name: SoCPK
methodology: Chinese SoC performance and efficiency database (CPU and GPU energy-efficiency curves).
notes: Registered but holds no records yet. Planned for chipset efficiency data.

name: DXOMARK
methodology: Lab and field protocol for camera, display, audio and battery scoring.
notes: Camera scores recorded for the latest flagships from 22 September 2026 (shown as evidence, not yet part of the site's camera score).

name: Tom's Guide
methodology: Standard battery test: continuous web surfing over a cellular connection at 150 nits until empty.

name: Android Authority
methodology: Long-form reviews after at least a week of use, with benchmark, stress-test and charging measurements.

name: 9to5Google
methodology: Experience-based reviews after daily use.

name: Trusted Reviews
notes: Linked here through its YouTube video reviews.

name: Dave2D
methodology: Experience-based video reviews and first impressions.

name: Ben's Gadget Reviews (Ben Sin)
methodology: Video reviews with a focus on Chinese-market and global flagships and their cameras.

name: SomeGadgetGuy (Juan Bagnell)
methodology: Experience-based video reviews.

name: Tech Advisor
methodology: News and reviews; used here for announced specifications only.

name: AnTuTu Benchmark
methodology: The benchmark's developer. Its monthly ranking lists the average of all results for popular models (global data, excluding China).

name: 快科技 (MyDrivers)
notes: Chinese technology news (formerly 驱动之家): launches, chips and prices in China. Headlines only; not evidence until an article is read and added.

name: IT之家 (IT Home)
notes: Chinese technology news: phone launches, software updates and chip news, often first with China-market models.

name: 爱范儿 (ifanr)
notes: Chinese technology publication with hands-on reviews of Chinese-market flagships.
